# Templates for the fake secrets in tests/scrub_secrets.rs. Nothing here is a
# secret or looks like one to a scanner: the test builds every {NAME} at run
# time (a prefix assembled from pieces, then a tail of random-looking
# characters), so no token-shaped string is ever committed.
# One case per line, three tab-separated fields:
#   kind <TAB> secret <TAB> text
# `secret` is what must NOT survive Scrubber::new(&["zachary"], &["fedora-box"],
# &["/home/zachary"]) .scrub and .scrub_message; `text` must contain it.
# {NAME} is built by the test; anything else is literal. "\n" is a line break.
# Add lines, never edit them.
github-ghp	{GHP}	GITHUB_TOKEN={GHP}
github-gho	{GHO}	remote: using oauth token {GHO} for github.com
github-fine-grained	{GH_FINE}	git clone https://x-access-token:{GH_FINE}@github.com/o/r.git
gitlab	{GITLAB}	GITLAB_TOKEN: {GITLAB}

slack-xoxp	{SLACK_P}	slack token {SLACK_P} rejected
